@MeasureTheory.integral_integral : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} β]
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_1} α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_2} β} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_3} E]
  [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_2} ν] [inst_4 : NormedSpace.{0, u_3} ℝ E] [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_1} μ] {f : α → β → E},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_3, max u_2 u_1} (Function.uncurry.{u_1, u_2, u_3 + 1} f)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_2} μ ν) →
    Eq.{u_3 + 1} (∫ (x : α), ∫ (y : β), f x y ∂ν ∂μ)
      (∫ (z : Prod.{u_1, u_2} α β), f z.1 z.2 ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_2} μ ν)
